scope: Administrator encrypted backup creation, key readiness, listing and authenticated download through daemon API, CLI and settings; restore installation remains open
checks: Private external raw 32-byte keys and explicit base64 environment keys; invalid lengths, public modes and symbolic links rejected; disposed key buffers cleared.

Administrator scope and recent password confirmation enforced for creation/download; missing keys do not prevent ordinary startup; authority revalidated after key access and before archive publication.
Index-mode registered source folders included automatically, with extra allowed roots; embedding descriptors and source requirements read from captured state.
Free-space admission and one active backup per state store; complete and partial archive names distinguish unavailable files.
Created archive can be listed, downloaded, authenticated and manifest-verified; API responses forbid caching and path traversal is rejected.
CLI uses an ephemeral stepped-up session, streams to a private temporary file, checks announced length, refuses overwrite and removes incomplete downloads.
Expected configuration, composition and OpenAPI contract additions reviewed and accepted; existing API operations preserved.
notes: Initial expected snapshot changes were reviewed before refreshing YAML aliases, service composition and OpenAPI goldens.

A revocation check initially returned a generic 503 because AuthorityChangedException inherits InvalidOperationException; the explicit 403 branch and post-key-read reauthorization passed final API and full-suite tests.
The first full test run also passed 2294 tests, but its fixed TRX name overwrote earlier project result files. The final run retained independent project files and hashes.
An initial time-zone-specific browser rerun observed the default local zone. The final fixture asserts UTC before readiness and uses a fresh port; both final workflows and archive verifications pass.
After the final full regression, only the isolated browser fixture and browser assertions changed. Production code is unchanged from that regression.
No production service, data, key material, backup or calendar subscription was modified.
limitations: Restore verifies in isolated staging only; installation, path remapping, account-epoch increment and index rebuild remain open.
Automatic key provisioning, rotation, export, abandoned-workspace recovery and pre-migration integration remain open; backup.keep is not yet enforced.
Archive listing is capped at 128 newest matching archives.
Full daemon backup/restore under sustained edits, large-corpus resource qualification and hardened deployment remain required.
Restore staging currently requires space for both the authenticated plaintext package and extracted files.
